text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahhh...! Fuji-san, your mom's musical 
was seriously the greatest!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad to hear that. This 
production is my absolute favorite among 
my mother's works. I really wanted you to 
see it, Pokke!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Man, it totally lived up to your 
recommendation, Fuji-san! I still have 
goosebumps all over!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You used to perform in sparkly shows like 
that back in the day too, right? That's 
freakin' ameeezing!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I can still recite the lines 
straight through even now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, King, my father...! Please 
reconsider! War will only bring sorrow 
upon the people of this land!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-What? Whaaaaaat!?!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What was that just now!? Magic? 
Hypnosis!? You looked like an actual 
princess, Fuji-san!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!! You say the sweetest things, 
Pokke.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Since you're so intrigued, care to try 
acting yourself? It should be a great 
stimulation for you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the handwritten notes. There, the 
script is ready. I'll play the foreign 
princess, so could you play the king, 
Pokke?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The king, huh? Alright! I'll give it a 
shot!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No, my King, you must not fear. Did you 
not once say it yourself? That you love 
this land and its people from the bottom 
of your heart?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"B-But... is it right for me... no, for 
WE... to change the traditions of this 
land that generations of kings have 
protected... or something..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaargh~~!! I sound like a total robot!! 
Damn it, how do you make it look so cool 
and natural like that, Fuji-san!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Alright!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"My beloved, please take my hand. I wish 
to show only you the sparkle of the jewels 
dancing deep within my eyes."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: *heart thumps wildly*!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at that expression. You're the 
spitting image of a king moved by a 
princess's words.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it! That wasn't acting, 
you legitimately knocked me off my feet!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, I did improvise that line. Playful 
little surprises like that are the best 
part of acting!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Jokes aside, listen closely, Pokke. A 
script is merely an outline. Acting comes 
from the heart.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Listen to what I say, and just speak 
whatever comes to mind. It doesn't matter 
if it deviates from the script a little.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whatever comes to mind... I see! Let's do 
this!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"There is nothing to fear, my King. If 
your kingdom and mine forge a bond of 
friendship, a wondrous future awaits us."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Have you forgotten that moonlit night? 
When our eyes met and we danced together, 
did our hearts not become one?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's right! With you and me 
together, we can do anything! Our meeting 
was pure destiny!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna smash open the doors to a brand 
new eraaa!! I'll let loose a roar of 
triumph that echoes across the world!! 
WOOOOOOOOAHHH!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy, I 
spotted the two of them immersed in a 
passionate performance. Before I knew it, 
I stopped and watched captivated until the 
end alongside other horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? When did so many people gather 
here...!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That was truly wonderful, Pokke. You felt 
like a wild, powerful king.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That was only because your acting was so 
good, Fuji-san. I just said whatever I 
felt in the moment...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Expressing what you genuinely feel—that's 
the key. Acting is simply conveying the 
truth seen by the performer to the 
audience.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's why it can move people's hearts and 
inspire them. That is the true nature of 
what you called magic and hypnosis.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I see, I think I get it now. Though...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the only role I can pull off is 
"myself." Being able to transform into a 
lovely princess or a cool magician... You 
really are incredible, Fuji-san!
